name: Isaac Newton
hook: The apple, the prism and the laws of motion — Jeopardy's favorite English scientist.

facts.label: Woolsthorpe Manor
facts.statement: Newton was born at Woolsthorpe Manor in 1642, and the apple tree outside his bedroom window is still shown to visitors.

facts.label: the three laws of motion
facts.statement: Newton's three laws of motion begin with the law of inertia; he set them out in the Principia in 1687.

facts.label: universal gravitation
facts.statement: Newton showed that gravitational force depends on just two things: the masses involved and the distance between them.

facts.label: the prism
facts.statement: Newton used a prism to split white sunlight into its spectrum of colors, a landmark of his work in optics.

facts.label: the reflecting telescope
facts.statement: In 1668 Newton built the first reflecting telescope, using a mirror instead of a lens to get a sharper image.

facts.label: Gottfried Leibniz
facts.statement: Newton feuded for decades with the German mathematician Leibniz over who invented calculus.

facts.label: Cambridge
facts.statement: Newton studied at Trinity College, Cambridge, and later represented Cambridge University in Parliament.
